text:
marta: Quick postmortem follow-up for the Aureus dedicated cluster. Root cause: asymmetric routes + intermittent on-prem NAT state that occasionally created a transient forwarding loop between our peering and their edge. Need clear owners for remediation, CI validation, monitoring, and customer coordination. @sanjay @lena @tom please take.

sanjay: I can take the route hygiene work. Plan: add a de-dup pass to route-prop, tighten BGP export filters, and add a fallback that withdraws problematic routes if flap rate spikes. Will open PR and a short rollback doc. ETA: PR by Wed EOD.

lena: I’ll run the on-prem config audit with Aureus ops. Checklist: kernel/NAT config, iptables state save, and vendor firmware version. If firmware is affected, escalate for a vendor patch timeline. Need Aureus maintenance window.

tom: I’ll own validation in CI and blueprints. Will create an e2e that simulates asymmetric path + NAT translation flips and asserts no packet duplication/loop. Also add a lightweight chaos test to our nightly smoke. ETA: branch in 5 days.

vika: Intro to Aureus ops sent in DM. Filed ticket: INC-4629 and added Aureus contact + preliminary maintenance slots.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-4629 "Aureus peering/NAT drift investigation"  assignee: network-team  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4629

marta: Monitoring item: add an alert for path asymmetry and NAT translation churn. Suggest alert conditions: route_flap_count > 3 in 5m OR nat_conn_reassoc_rate > 1% in 5m. @sanjay can you author the alert + a Grafana panel?

sanjay: Yep. Draft queries: 
```
sum(rate(route_flap_total{customer="aureus"}[5m])) by (peer)
```
and
```
sum(rate(nat_conn_reassoc_total{customer="aureus"}[5m])) / max(1, sum(rate(nat_conn_total{customer="aureus"}[5m])))
```
Will add a panel and an alert rule that pages on critical and a slack notification to #incidents.

lena: Note: Aureus runs older NAT firmware (vendor v2.3.1) and their queue for fixes is a few weeks. If vendor patch is required we should scope a mitigation (route-holdback + CT table pruning) as a stopgap. I’ll capture options in INC-4629.

tom: For the CI tests I'll mock the on-prem NAT behavior to avoid touching customer infra. Will include a replay of the exact packet-timing that caused the loop in the A/V logs.

marta: Action summary added to postmortem doc: 
1) sanjay 94 route hygiene + BGP export filters + alerting (PR -> #PR-890) 94 ETA Wed EOD
2) lena 94 on-prem audit + vendor escalation (ticket INC-4629) 94 ETA Mon next week
3) tom 94 CI/blueprints e2e + chaos test 94 ETA next Fri
4) vika 94 customer coordination + maintenance window confirmation 94 ETA tomorrow
5) add monitoring & dashboard (owner: sanjay)

marta: Let's reconvene for a 15m sync next Tue 09:30 PT to confirm PR+tests+maintenance. Please update INC-4629 with milestones and drop links to PR + CI when ready. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
